title: Start with text
description: A page begins with one visible text element.

title: Add one widget
description: A textBox can stand on its own before labels and layout are introduced.

title: Compose an explicit label
description: labledBox owns the caption and position while textBox remains the child control.

title: Decorate three widgets
description: The same lbl_* and box_* families apply directly to different widgets.

title: Arrange five fields
description: formlet supplies columns and shared presentation defaults; one child overrides them.

title: Edit multiline text
description: textBoxArea is a dedicated Gramlot field backed by a native textarea, with the same binding, label, validation and formlet behavior as other inputs.

title: Symbolic date entry
description: Edit the date as ordinary text, or open the calendar. Type symbolic expressions such as oggi+15 directly. Calendar selection stays provisional: click outside the field and calendar to confirm. Enter in the text field also confirms; Escape cancels. Try 010325, ieri, mese scorso or 2 trimestre. Periods use their starting date. This example uses Italian and a fixed reference date of 11 September 2026. The stored date changes only after a valid entry.

title: Enter a date
description: Choose a date, then leave the field. The output subscribes to the same typed Data value. The symbolic-date lesson adds natural-language entry; this example introduces only the date widget.

title: Number formatting and precision
description: Change format, decimal places and locale. Places controls presentation only: focus Amount to edit its full precision, then press Enter or leave the field to confirm. Escape restores the stored value. The Result box compares formatted text with the exact stored Decimal. Percent edits use the underlying fraction: 0.15 displays as 15%. Enter numbers without grouping separators.

title: Add a display mask
description: Type a name. mask substitutes the displayed value for %s; it does not modify Data or interpret HTML. An empty value still displays the surrounding mask.

title: Format the same date twice
description: Choose a date and compare the numeric pattern with a localized long date. format runs before mask. Both outputs read the same typed date; formatting leaves the stored value unchanged.

title: dataFormula and dataController
description: One small example per concept. Enter values in the fields to run the logic. Each example has its own Data.

examples.title: Reactive formula
examples.description: Enter quantity and price. Changing either field recalculates the total: both formula inputs use ^.

examples.title: Passive price
examples.description: Enter price first, then quantity. Only quantity triggers the formula. The = input reads the current local price at execution time; it is a passive/lazy read, not a remote resolver.

examples.title: Inline expression
examples.description: Enter quantity and price. The == expression computes the displayed value directly, without a separate total in Data.

examples.title: Controller
examples.description: Type a name. The controller runs a JavaScript script when name changes and writes a message into Data.

group: Data and logic / Formulas and controllers

title: Change Source, keep Data
description: Generate contacts replaces the contact Data with 1–10 fictional contacts and moves the slider to that count. The slider only changes the visible cards: hidden contacts keep their data, and the visible count is limited to the contacts in the Bag. Open the inspector below the cards to explore Data and Source. Drag the divider to make room for more columns.

title: Publish and subscribe
description: Edit Name and publish a greeting: two independent controllers receive the same message. Typing alone does not publish. The second button uses this.publish: its nodeId sender qualifies ready as sender_ready. Topics belong to this mounted application.

title: Stack buttons and page topics
description: Select a page with the external stackButtons or publish a switchPage command. The showing subscriber reports the visible page and counts History activations. Selecting History again while it is already visible does not add an activation. Initial visibility also emits showing; this example starts on Details.

title: Validate one field
description: Local field validation works without a form or persistence layer.

title: Save a memory form
description: A form reports dirty, valid and pending state, saves to MemoryStore and restores its saved baseline.

title: Reuse validation rules
description: An ordinary dictionary or object can apply the same validation rules to several fields without introducing a validation class.

title: Required and length rules
description: Enter fewer than three characters, then leave the field. The widget reports the failed rule. Validation describes field state; it is not server-side validation or a persistence guarantee.

title: Validate an email
description: Enter an incomplete address, leave the field, then correct it. The built-in email rule checks syntax locally; it does not verify that a mailbox exists.

title: Validate a numeric range
description: Enter a number outside 1–10 and leave the field. min and max constrain the value; they are independent from display formatting and decimal places.

title: A Bag as a tree
description: Expand people and select Ada or Grace. storeTree reads the nested Bag and writes the selected relative path into Data. Captions belong to node attributes; the path uses node labels.

title: Display records in a grid
description: Each child Bag is one record. Select a row: selectedKey contains its stable Bag label, not its visible position. This is a resident display grid; cells are not editable in this lesson.

title: Rows stored as attributes
description: datamode="attr" reads fields from row-node attributes instead of child Bags. The amount column formats numbers to two displayed decimal places; Data retains its original precision.
